Tata Trusts Appoints Abhishek Manu Singhvi Amidst Dispute

Tata Trusts has appointed senior Supreme Court lawyer Abhishek Manu Singhvi to represent its interests in an ongoing dispute. The dispute appears to be heading towards court, with Singhvi stating that ending shareholder rights poses a serious threat to corporate governance.
